2.4 Perform Command Injection - {Findings: A Python script was written to automate the process of issuing commands and receiving results. The script uses the requests library to log in and issue requests, and the re library to match results. A class, Terminal, is defined which inherits from the Cmd class. In the Terminal class, the __init__() method is used to initiate a session and log in with username 'admin' and password 'NET_45JDX23'. The default() method is defined to encode commands, post them to 'http://10.10.10.105/diag.php', and print the results. The do_shell() method is defined to create a reverse shell. The script ends by creating an instance of Terminal and entering a command loop with cmdloop().}:
(status change only)
